steps.title: Get Food Fast
steps.body: Punch 1 tree → crafting table → wooden sword. Hunt cows or sheep on day one; aim for 10 raw meat before night.

steps.title: Find a Safe Base
steps.body: A 3×3 hole with a door works for night 1. Upgrade to a proper base once you've got stone tools.

steps.title: Claim Your Land
steps.body: Use /claim to protect a chunk. Use /trust <player> to share a claim with friends.

steps.title: Find a Waystone
steps.body: Waystones let you fast-travel. There are 12 public ones near spawn — explore to find them.

steps.title: Join Events
steps.body: Weekly events are posted in #events on Discord. Build battles, mob hunts, treasure hunts.

steps.title: Avoid Lag
steps.body: Install Sodium (it's allowed). Lower render distance if you're on a laptop. Ask in #support for help.

faq.a: Yes! Tag us and we might feature your video on the Gallery.
